danhengil.name: Dan Heng · Imbibitor Lunae
danhengil.title: The Azure Dragon's Heir
danhengil.description: The true and awakened form of Dan Heng, wielding the power of the Azure Dragon. As a master of the Destruction path, he unleashes devastating Imaginary attacks that shatter the battlefield.
danhengil.bioSub: "The dragon awakens. And with it, the storm."
bioContent: Dan Heng · Imbibitor Lunae is the awakened form of the Astral Express's guardian, Dan Heng.
He has inherited the power of the Azure Dragon, one of the legendary Xianzhou Vidyadhara, granting him immense control over Imaginary forces.
He is a being of calm resolve, but when his full power is unleashed, he brings forth a storm that can level mountains and reshape the battlefield.

features.title: Azure Dragon
features.desc: Wields the ancient power of the Xianzhou's Vidyadhara.

features.title: Destruction
features.desc: Devastating area-of-effect and single-target Imaginary damage.

features.title: Imaginary
features.desc: His attacks distort reality, dealing massive Imaginary damage.

skills.name: Dragon's Breath
skills.desc: Dan Heng strikes with a blast of Imaginary energy.

skills.name: Azure Burst
skills.desc: Unleashes a torrent of draconic energy, dealing heavy Imaginary damage to enemies.

skills.name: Eternal Requiem
skills.desc: The Azure Dragon descends, dealing massive Imaginary damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Dragon's Resolve
skills.desc: Gains a stack of 'Dragon's Might' for each enemy hit, increasing ATK.

seele.name: Seele
seele.title: The Quantum Butterfly
seele.description: A fierce member of Wildfire from the underworld of Belobog. Seele is a fast-paced single-target DPS who harnesses the power of Quantum to eliminate her enemies with lightning speed.
seele.bioSub: "I'll cut through any obstacle that stands in my way."
bioContent: Seele is a member of Wildfire, a resistance group fighting for the freedom of Belobog's underworld.
She wields the power of the Hunt path, specializing in eliminating high-priority targets with devastating single-target Quantum damage.
Her speed and precision make her a formidable opponent on the battlefield, always striking before her enemies can react.

features.title: Quantum Damage
features.desc: Deals powerful Quantum damage to single targets.

features.title: Speed
features.desc: Her fast attacks allow her to take down enemies quickly.

skills.name: Quantum Strike
skills.desc: Seele strikes a single enemy with Quantum energy.

skills.name: Butterfly's Dance
skills.desc: Seele unleashes a flurry of attacks on a single enemy.

skills.name: Quantum Eclipse
skills.desc: Seele delivers a devastating blow that deals massive Quantum damage.

skills.name: Resurgence
skills.desc: After defeating an enemy, Seele gains an extra turn.

jingyuan.name: Jing Yuan
jingyuan.title: The Cloud Knight General
jingyuan.description: The general of the Xianzhou Luofu's Cloud Knights. A master of strategy and Lightning, Jing Yuan commands the Lightning Lord to deliver devastating Erudition attacks.
jingyuan.bioSub: "The storm is a part of me. And I am its master."
bioContent: Jing Yuan is the general of the Xianzhou Luofu's Cloud Knights.
He is a master of the Erudition path, capable of controlling the mythical Lightning Lord to strike down multiple enemies with devastating AoE damage.
Despite his calm and approachable demeanor, he is a brilliant strategist who has defended the Luofu from countless threats.

features.title: Lightning Lord
features.desc: Commands a mythical beast of lightning.

features.title: Strategic Mind
features.desc: His tactics are as sharp as his blade.

skills.name: Storm's Edge
skills.desc: Jing Yuan strikes with a blade of lightning.

skills.name: Lightning's Wrath
skills.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning that deals AoE damage.

skills.name: Lord's Decree
skills.desc: The Lightning Lord descends, dealing massive Lightning damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Benevolent Thunder
skills.desc: Increases the Lightning Lord's follow-up attack damage.

blade.name: Blade
blade.title: The Immortal Swordsman
blade.description: A mysterious swordsman seeking death. Blade wields the power of the Destruction path, consuming his own HP to deal devastating Imaginary damage.
blade.bioSub: "Death is not the end. It is merely a beginning."
bioContent: Blade is a member of the Stellaron Hunters, an immortal swordsman cursed with eternal life.
He wields the power of the Destruction path, sacrificing his own health to unleash devastating Imaginary attacks.
His past is shrouded in tragedy, and he seeks nothing but an end to his eternal suffering.

features.title: Destruction
features.desc: Attacks consume his own HP for power.

skills.name: Soul Rend
skills.desc: Blade slashes with his sword, dealing Imaginary damage.

skills.name: Blood Thirst
skills.desc: Blade sacrifices HP to deal massive Imaginary damage.

skills.name: Eternal Requiem
skills.desc: Unleashes the full power of his curse, dealing devastating Imaginary damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Immortal Will
skills.desc: When Blade is knocked down, he revives with a percentage of his HP.

kafka.name: Kafka
kafka.title: The Elegant Stellaron Hunter
kafka.description: A member of the mysterious Stellaron Hunters, Kafka wields lightning with deadly precision. She specializes in applying Shock and triggering devastating follow-up attacks.
kafka.bioSub: "The universe is full of surprises. I intend to enjoy every single one."
bioContent: Kafka is a member of the Stellaron Hunters, a group of enigmatic individuals who operate outside the laws of the universe.
Her powers are a testament to her connection to the Nihility path. She can weave lightning into her attacks, paralyzing enemies with Shock.
Despite her fearsome reputation, Kafka is not without her own code of ethics. She often appears to help those in need — though always on her own terms.

features.title: Stellaron Hunter
features.desc: Operates outside the laws of the universe.

features.title: Nihility
features.desc: Excels at debuffs and follow-up attacks.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning with a chance to apply Shock.

skills.name: Caress of the Spider
skills.desc: Unleashes a web of lightning that applies Shock to all enemies.

skills.name: Twilight of the Hunt
skills.desc: Triggers massive chain lightning, consuming all Shock stacks for bonus damage.

skills.name: Nihility's Embrace
skills.desc: Gains stacks of DoT Amplification on shocked enemies, increasing follow-up attack damage.

bronya.name: Bronya
bronya.title: The Silvermane Commander
bronya.description: The commander of the Silvermane Guards of Belobog. Bronya is a top-tier support who excels at boosting her team's ATK and manipulating turn order with the Harmony path.
bioContent: Bronya is the commander of the Silvermane Guards of Belobog.
She follows the Harmony path, using her leadership to boost the combat effectiveness of her entire team.
Raised as a noble, she has grown into a wise and just leader, fighting tirelessly for the survival of her people.

features.title: Commander
features.desc: Her leadership inspires the entire team.

skills.name: Wind Strike
skills.desc: A swift wind attack.

skills.name: March of the Guards
skills.desc: Boosts an ally's ATK and advances their action.

skills.name: Belobog's Glory
skills.desc: Boosts the entire team's ATK and removes debuffs.

skills.name: Battlefield Presence
skills.desc: Increases the team's damage based on Bronya's ATK.

luocha.name: Luocha
luocha.title: The Mysterious Merchant
luocha.description: A mysterious merchant from beyond the stars. Luocha is a powerful healer on the Abundance path, excelling at removing debuffs and keeping his team alive.
luocha.bioSub: "Debts must always be repaid. One way or another."
bioContent: Luocha is a mysterious merchant who travels the galaxy.
He is a follower of the Abundance path, gifted with incredible healing abilities that can cleanse even the most potent curses.
Despite his friendly demeanor, his true motives remain a secret to everyone he meets.

skills.name: Imaginary Blade
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Healing Pulse
skills.desc: Heals an ally and removes a debuff.

skills.name: Cycle of Life
skills.desc: Heals all allies and deals damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Mercenary's Favor
skills.desc: Increases healing done to allies who are below a certain HP threshold.

silverwolf.name: Silver Wolf
silverwolf.title: The Ultimate Hacker
silverwolf.description: A genius hacker from the Stellaron Hunters. Silver Wolf uses her unique abilities to implant weaknesses onto enemies, making them vulnerable to any element.
silverwolf.bioSub: "Hacking reality is just a matter of finding the right bugs."
bioContent: Silver Wolf is a member of the Stellaron Hunters and a legendary hacker.
She follows the Nihility path, using her coding skills to 'hack' reality and implant elemental weaknesses into her opponents.
She is playful and mischievous, treating combat like a video game, but her efficiency is undeniable.

skills.name: Quantum Bolt
skills.desc: Deals Quantum damage.

skills.name: System Shock
skills.desc: Implements a random weakness onto an enemy.

skills.name: Hack & Slash
skills.desc: Deals Quantum damage and reduces enemy DEF.

skills.name: Debugging
skills.desc: Reduces the target's effect resistance when a weakness is implemented.

asta.name: Asta
asta.title: The Passionate Researcher
asta.description: A researcher at Herta Space Station with a fiery passion for discovery. Asta is a Harmony character who boosts the team's ATK and speed, making her a valuable support.
bioContent: Asta is a researcher at the Herta Space Station.
She is a follower of the Harmony path, using her fiery enthusiasm to boost the ATK and Speed of her allies.
Her research focuses on the cosmos, and she treats every battle as an exciting experiment.

skills.name: Firebolt
skills.desc: Deals Fire damage.

skills.name: Astral Inspiration
skills.desc: Boosts an ally's ATK.

skills.name: Supernova
skills.desc: Boosts the entire team's ATK based on Asta's stacks.

skills.name: Observation
skills.desc: Gains stacks of ATK boost for each enemy hit.

natasha.name: Natasha
natasha.title: The Underground Doctor
natasha.description: A doctor from Belobog's underworld. Natasha is a kind-hearted healer on the Abundance path, providing essential healing and debuff removal for her team.
natasha.bioSub: "A healthy body is a healthy mind."
bioContent: Natasha is a dedicated doctor from the Underworld of Belobog.
She is a follower of the Abundance path, providing reliable healing and cleansing debuffs to keep her allies in fighting shape.
Despite the harsh conditions of the underworld, she remains caring and compassionate.

skills.name: Surgical Strike
skills.desc: Deals Physical damage.

skills.name: Healing Salve
skills.desc: Heals an ally.

skills.name: Panacea
skills.desc: Heals all allies and removes debuffs.

skills.name: Bedside Manner
skills.desc: Increases healing done to allies with low HP.

pela.name: Pela
pela.title: The Ice-Cold Intelligence Officer
pela.description: An intelligence officer of the Silvermane Guards. Pela uses her ice-cold precision to dispel enemy buffs and shred their defenses on the Nihility path.
bioContent: Pela is an intelligence officer for the Silvermane Guards.
She follows the Nihility path, specializing in dispelling enemy buffs and reducing their defense, making them easy targets.
She is calm, collected, and highly analytical, always thinking several steps ahead.

skills.name: Ice Shot
skills.desc: Deals Ice damage.

skills.name: Defense Shred
skills.desc: Reduces an enemy's DEF.

skills.name: Full Sweep
skills.desc: Deals Ice damage to all enemies and dispels their buffs.

skills.name: Strategic Analysis
skills.desc: Increases efficiency of defense reduction.

sushang.name: Sushang
sushang.title: The Eager Young Warrior
sushang.description: A young warrior from the Xianzhou Alliance. Sushang is a Hunt character who combines Physical damage with speed, taking down single targets with rapid strikes.
bioContent: Sushang is a young and eager warrior from the Xianzhou Alliance.
She is a follower of the Hunt path, excelling at single-target Physical damage.
She is energetic and determined to prove herself, often charging into battle without hesitation.

skills.name: Swift Strike
skills.desc: Deals Physical damage.

skills.name: Rapid Assault
skills.desc: Unleashes a rapid flurry of attacks on a single enemy.

skills.name: Verdict
skills.desc: Deals massive Physical damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Swordheart
skills.desc: Increases damage against enemies with lower HP.

tingyun.name: Tingyun
tingyun.title: The Foxian Merchant
tingyun.description: A charming Foxian merchant from the Xianzhou Luofu. Tingyun is a Harmony character who boosts ally ATK and provides energy regeneration.
tingyun.bioSub: "A little charm goes a long way."
bioContent: Tingyun is a charismatic Foxian merchant from the Xianzhou Luofu.
She walks the Harmony path, using her charm to boost her allies' ATK and even restore their energy.
Though she appears delicate, she is a skilled negotiator and a capable fighter.

skills.name: Lightning Whip
skills.desc: Deals Lightning damage.

skills.name: Benediction
skills.desc: Boosts an ally's ATK and provides energy regeneration.

skills.name: Fox's Gambit
skills.desc: Boosts the entire team's ATK.

skills.name: Merchant's Grace
skills.desc: Increases the team's damage when Tingyun is on the field.

qingque.name: Qingque
qingque.title: The Lazy Diviner
qingque.description: A lazy but incredibly skilled diviner of the Xianzhou Luofu. Qingque follows the Erudition path, using a unique tile-drawing mechanic to unleash powerful attacks.
qingque.bioSub: "Why work hard when you can work smart?"
bioContent: Qingque is a diviner of the Xianzhou Luofu who is famous for her lazy attitude.
Despite her laziness, she is a genius on the Erudition path. Her attacks revolve around drawing mahjong tiles, which can lead to massive bursts of damage if she's lucky.
She prefers playing games and napping over working, but when pushed, she proves her incredible talent.

features.title: Gambler
features.desc: Uses a unique tile-drawing mechanic for power.

skills.name: Tile Strike
skills.desc: Deals Quantum damage.

skills.name: Draw Hand
skills.desc: Draws tiles, enhancing the next attack.

skills.name: Wild Card
skills.desc: Deals massive AoE Quantum damage based on the number of tiles drawn.

skills.name: Lady Luck
skills.desc: Increases critical damage based on tile stacks.

herta.name: Herta
herta.title: The Genius Owner
herta.description: The genius owner of Herta Space Station. Herta is an Erudition character who uses Ice to deal massive AoE damage and trigger follow-up attacks.
herta.bioSub: "I am always right. It's a fact."
bioContent: Herta is the genius owner of the Herta Space Station.
She is a follower of the Erudition path, utilizing Ice to freeze her enemies and strike them down with powerful follow-up attacks.
She is highly confident in her intelligence and views everything as a fascinating experiment.

skills.name: Ice Bolt
skills.desc: Deals Ice damage.

skills.name: Crystalline Whip
skills.desc: Deals Ice damage to all enemies.

skills.name: The Herta Curse
skills.desc: Deals massive Ice damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Experimental Follow-up
skills.desc: Triggers a follow-up attack when an ally's HP drops below a certain threshold.
